title: Western Blot Protocol
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iy5cfy6

steps.title: Prepare endometrial tissue lysate
steps.instruction: Extract proteins from endometrial tissue and determine concentration.

substeps.instruction: Use T-PER Tissue Protein Extraction Reagent to prepare lysate from endometrial tissue.
Remove a small volume of lysate and determine protein concentration using the BCA Protein Assay Kit.

steps.title: Run SDS-PAGE gel
steps.instruction: Separate proteins using an SDS-PAGE gel with a 10% separation gel and 5% spacer gel.

substeps.instruction: Load 60 ug total proteins per pore into the wells, along with a molecular weight marker.
Run the gel for 90 min at 100 V.

steps.title: Transfer proteins to PVDF membrane
steps.instruction: Transfer proteins from the gel to a PVDF membrane.

substeps.instruction: Activate the PVDF membrane with methanol for 1 min.
Rinse the membrane with transfer buffer before preparing the stack.
Run the transfer at 100 V for 90 min.

steps.title: Wash and block membrane
steps.instruction: Wash and block the membrane to prevent non-specific binding.

substeps.instruction: Wash the membrane three times with TBST (containing 5 percent skimmed milk powder) for 5 min each.
Block the membrane overnight at 4°C using blocking buffer.
Wash the membrane four times with TBST for 5 min each.

steps.title: Incubate with secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Detect target proteins using a conjugated secondary antibody.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the membrane with the recommended dilution of conjugated secondary antibody in blocking buffer at room temperature for 1 h.
Wash the membrane five times with TBST for 5 min each.

steps.title: Acquire images
steps.instruction: Perform colorimetric detection using normal image scanning methods to acquire images.
